hero.title: What is PflegeNavigator EU?
hero.text: A digital navigation portal that guides people in need of care, people with disabilities and victims of violence through complex social-law application and appeal procedures — accessibly, in several languages and supported by AI.

story.title: How it began: a personal journey
story.p1: PflegeNavigator EU was not designed on a drawing board. It started with the personal predicament of our founder, André Schulze. After a serious act of violence with significant health consequences, he had to navigate several parallel German social-law procedures at once — long-term care insurance, severe disability status and victim compensation.
story.p2: Applications, appeals, deadlines and expert reports piled up. To stay capable of acting at all, he began using AI-assisted tools for his own proceedings: to organise documents, to understand complex decisions and to prepare legally sound letters. At first this was done purely out of necessity.
story.subtitle: The realisation
story.p3: It quickly became clear that what helped him is missing for millions of people in the same situation: a structured, understandable, multilingual and accessible path through social law. Supported by modern tools and a highly secure server infrastructure, this grew into a fully functional portal.
story.statusNotice: A note on status: this portal is not evidence of full capability. It is the result of a long road taken in small steps — born of personal experience and carried by tools that make possible what would otherwise be out of reach.

mission.title: The mission
mission.text: To effectively remove barriers to access in social law. We bring together entitlements from five German social codes in a single, transparent place.

vision.title: The vision
vision.text: A world in which administrative and linguistic hurdles no longer stop anyone from claiming the support they are legally entitled to.

partner.title: Validated care partner
partner.text: Professionally and operationally backed by a binding cooperation agreement with Pflegedienst Lirio GmbH (Bielefeld, since 13 April 2026).

expert.title: Social-psychological assurance
expert.text: The system and its triage evaluations draw on the official professional assessment by Vedat Karasu (graduate social pedagogue, LWL Clinics Gütersloh).
